basis: The Over ons page (archived copy of the Cultuurhuis' own page) says it is registered as a cultural ANBI under the name Stichting Cultuurhuis Bergeijk and that its board is unpaid volunteers.

The Organisatie page describes Stichting De Nollen with an unpaid board and a governance code, and the Over het museum page names it a cultural ANBI; the site says R.W. van de Wint BV manages the grounds.

The 2025 annual report of Museum Dr8888 says the house is held in a separate stichting while Museum Dr8888 runs its operation and programme, and that a change to put its direction under Museum Dr8888 is being prepared.
The organisation page says the Park is run by an independent non-profit Foundation that manages the Jachthuis, while the Government Buildings Agency funds the Jachthuis maintenance.
The museum's Organization page says the Cuypershuis is part of the municipality of Roermond, is a municipal museum and is registered under the name Municipality of Roermond, Cuypershuis.

The 2025 annual report sections 2, 3 and 4 say Stichting Hendrik Chabot was founded in 1992, is a cultural ANBI, runs a supervisory board model since March 2023 and pays its employees under the museum CAO.
The museum's Visit page names the Het Blaakse Bos Foundation as the operator and lists Ed R. de Graaf as its founder.

The 2025 annual report says Nieuwe Instituut manages Huis Sonneveld, is a stichting whose supervisory board employs the management board and approved the 2026 budget, and reports its staff as employees.

The Jan de Jong Stichting page says Hendrick de Keyser acquired the house in 2017, and the association's Organisatie page says it is a vereniging whose board sets the budget and which has just over 80 employees.

The Kulturetaten page lists Vigelandmuseet as part of the agency, and section 4 of the 2026 allocation letter sets out the budget decision of the city council (bystyret) with targets for Vigelandmuseet.

The Eiere og styre page says Vestfoldmuseene IKS was created in 2009 as an intermunicipal company owned by seven municipalities and Vestfold county, and the 2024 annual report lists Munchs hus among its units.
